Derived-date gold label — the first anniversary of the Commencement Date. Unlike heritage-bank-walnut-creek-ygnacio-plaza's next_escalation (a documented miss), this one is expected to actually compute correctly: lib/dates/criticalDates.ts's deriveNextEscalationDate only requires the word "annual" to appear in the extracted escalation_type/escalation_schedule text and then adds one year to the commencement date — it never has to interpret the CPI-indexed amount itself (only pdf.js-extracted rate text would need that), so the fact that the rent increase's magnitude is CPI-variable doesn't block the date computation the way an unrecognized cadence would. A useful contrast case to Heritage Bank's.
